text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf's vice-president and<n>right hand, Air
Groove, worries for her<n>wellbeing since she insists
on<n>balancing her student council duties<n>with a
grueling training schedule.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The other vice-president, Narita Brian,<n>comes off as
blunt at first, but she<n>clearly cares for the student
council's<n>new general manager.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf seems delighted to<n>have people
looking up to her. Over<n>the course of the day, I catch
a<n>glimpse of her relationships with the<n>other student
council members.
